subject.title: feat(agents): inject Recently Completed Subagents into parent prompt

question: Should OpenClaw include recently completed child status and task anchors by default in eligible parent-agent prompts for 30 minutes, capped at eight newest entries?
rationale: This is a new default orchestration policy for existing sessions, not an established broken contract with one objectively correct implementation.

options.title: Accept bounded completion anchors
options.body: Merge the 30-minute, eight-entry block as the default parent-agent context after accepting the token and behavior tradeoff.

options.title: Keep active-only prompt context
options.body: Retain the current active-child prompt and rely on completion handoffs, transcript context, and subagent tools for finished-child information.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Expose completed-child anchors only in a deliberate orchestration mode rather than adding them to ordinary parent prompts.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded completion anchors
recommendation.body: Merge the 30-minute, eight-entry block as the default parent-agent context after accepting the token and behavior tradeoff.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied record identifies this contributor as the only concrete author of the proposed runtime behavior; feature-history ownership still needs a normal maintainer read.
